calls.title: [Internal] Website Planning & Design Review Sync
calls.summary: The team discussed the crucial need for unified design and content feedback to prevent delays in website development and ensure a smooth launch. Karen Henke pointed out that uncoordinated feedback had previously created confusion and delays in Bright Scout's work. To address this, they decided to consolidate feedback into a single source before it reaches the development team. Ashley Stirrup suggested a prep session on Tuesdays to align feedback ahead of meetings. Additionally, the homepage design was refined, with a preference for a clearer hero option, and key stats strategically placed. They agreed on user-friendly messaging for deployment options, differentiating between cloud and self-hosted offerings. Visual elements were reviewed for consistency, and final content refinements were made to target product teams better. The team expressed optimism about their progress towards aggressive deadlines.
calls.keywords: Website Design, Content Coordination, Deployment Options, Information Architecture, User Experience, Feedback Integration
